description: Calculates camera pose (position and orientation) relative to known AprilTag markers using a Perspective-n-Point algorithm

camera_bus_id.description: Camera USB bus ID used to resolve calibration files (for example: '0' or '0-1').

apriltag_map_path.description: Path to the apriltag map file

refinement_iterations.description: Maximum Levenberg-Marquardt refinement iterations after IPPE (one tag) or SQPnP (multiple tags). 0 disables refinement. More iterations cannot correct noisy corners or an incorrect tag map.
